description: This file defines the Tween class and related effects for jQuery animations, including easing functions and property hooks.

classes.name: Tween
classes.description: Represents an animation tween for a DOM element's property, handling the calculation and application of intermediate values during animations.

methods.name: Tween
methods.description: Constructor function for creating a new Tween instance.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the Tween object with element, options, property, end value, easing, and unit.

methods.name: cur
methods.description: Retrieves the current value of the property being animated.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Progresses the animation to a given percentage, updating the property accordingly.
